build.help: Type-check both blocks, then build both container images from source.

build-ci-image.help: Build the image the gates run in.

export-spec.help: Export the OpenAPI spec from the app factory (no server, temp DB).

generate-api.help: Export the contract, then regenerate the frontend client from it.

generate-client.help: Generate the frontend's typed schema from the committed contract.

website.help: Die Produktwebseite mit Hugo bauen (in Docker, HTML).

backup.help: Write a consistent SQLite snapshot (VACUUM INTO) into the environment's BACKUP_DIR.

down.help: Tear the target environment's stack down.

local.help: Run backend + frontend dev servers together (Ctrl-C stops both).

local-backend.help: Run the backend dev server (uvicorn --reload on :8000).

local-frontend.help: Run the frontend dev server (Next.js on :3000).

restore.help: Restore a snapshot (app stopped; the previous DB is kept).

rollout.help: Eine veröffentlichte Version über Portainer in die Zielumgebung ausliefern.

teardown.help: Den Stapel der Zielumgebung in Portainer ENTFERNEN (nicht nur anhalten).

up.help: Bring the stack up for the target environment (pull, then up -d).

update.help: Der lokale Weg in einem Schritt: Abbilder ziehen, Stack neu starten, Gesundheit pruefen.

logs.help: Show the target environment's container logs.

status.help: Show the target environment's containers and probe its health endpoint.

publish.help: Push the built images to the container registry (GHCR).

release.help: Build both images and push them to the registry.

check-completion.help: Fail if the committed shell completion differs from the manifest.

check-workflows.help: Fail if the committed workflows differ from the manifest.

claude-plugins.help: Die im Manifest erklaerten Claude-Code-Erweiterungen einrichten; wiederholbar.

completion.help: Regenerate the product's shell completion from its manifest (--check reports drift and writes nothing).

install.help: Provision the host tooling the kernel needs - today oras; idempotent.

workflows.help: Regenerate the GitHub workflows from this manifest.

auth-scopes.help: Grant the stored gh token the package scopes GHCR needs (interactive, idempotent).

prune-branches.help: Delete local branches already merged into main (squash-aware via gh).

submodules.help: git submodule update --init lib/platform (init the submodule a fresh worktree needs).

catalogue.help: List the task coordinates the delivery kernel offers, marking the namespaces this product's commands reach.

generate.help: Regenerate the product's CLI module from its manifest (--check reports drift and writes nothing).

check-contract.help: CI staleness gate (rule 3): the committed contract must match the code.

ci.help: The full CI gate: lint, the contract staleness check, then the test suites.

lint.help: Lint both blocks: ruff check + ruff format --check, then ESLint.

lint-backend.help: Lint the backend (ruff check + ruff format --check).

test.help: Run every gate the CI test job runs: backend pytest, frontend vitest, tsc --noEmit.

test-orchestrator.help: Run the orchestrator's own test suite (pytest).

typecheck.help: Type-check both blocks: mypy, then tsc --noEmit.

verify-spec.help: Fail if the committed contract differs from the exported one.
